articles.text: Apollo (APO) Completes Emerald And Questex Deals To Build A B2B Events Platform. Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) has completed the acquisitions of Emerald Holding and Questex. The deals combine the two businesses into a new B2B experiential events and media platform under Apollo-managed funds. A newly appointed executive team is taking charge of the combined platform following the transaction.
